body.name: Internal covariance-geometry probe at the rational witness
body.construction: Coordinate specialization gives \(\mathcal R_B(\omega_0)=\mathcal R_B\) and \(L_{\omega_0}(r)=L(r)\). The internally chosen probe \(G_{\omega_0}\) records only the largest of the three pairwise marginal contrast variances. Form its optimizer set \(\mathcal G(\omega_0)\) and compare that set with the explicitly projected feasible design \(r_{\mathrm{alt}}(\omega_0)\) under the full Gaussian minimax-regret functional.
